string.text: Extended Glock magazine compatible with all standard 9x19mm Glock variants. Offers enhanced 33-round capacity over default Glock magazines, originally intended for the Glock 18 machine pistol variants. Made in Austria.

Extended Glock magazine compatible with all Zone modified 9x18mm Glock variants. Offers enhanced 33-round capacity over default Glock magazines, originally intended for the Glock 18 machine pistol variants. Made in Austria.
